objective: Measure the financial effect of governing continuous enterprise data streams at state-transition boundaries rather than treating an entire workload as one provider call.

roles.provider_model: Produces classifications, transformations, recommendations, or candidate actions from stream events.
roles.stegverse: Admits, denies, receipts, reconstructs, replays, repairs, and preserves continuity across state transitions.
roles.verifier: Determines task correctness, policy compliance, state continuity, and outcome equivalence independently of lane cost.

required_lanes.description: Provider processes the full stream without StegVerse admission controls.
The same provider processes the same stream while StegVerse governs each declared commit boundary.
Replay, reconstruct, rollback, or repair from committed receipts without repeating the full provider execution where the requested operation permits it.

state_transition_model.commit_boundary_requirement: Every economically or operationally meaningful state mutation must have an explicit candidate, policy reference, evidence reference, admission result, execution result, and receipt.
state_transition_model.failure_rule: Failed, denied, malformed, retried, superseded, and recovered events remain in the financial and operational ledger.

financial_model.native_total_cost: provider_execution + retries + correction + rework + human_review + incidents + recovery + audit
financial_model.governed_total_cost: provider_execution_if_allowed + stegverse_admission + verification + receipts + storage + reconstruction + maintenance + human_review + incidents + recovery

token_and_germane_work_model.provider_tokens: Retain native input, cached, reasoning, and output token observations.
token_and_germane_work_model.germane_tokens: Count only task-relevant instructions, evidence, state, and output needed to produce the required outcome.
token_and_germane_work_model.non_germane_tokens: Record but exclude unrelated verbosity, duplicated context, malformed output, and task drift from the successful-work denominator.
token_and_germane_work_model.boundary: Token-equivalent is an accounting normalization only and must not be represented as literal model tokens, compute equivalence, or energy equivalence.

claim_boundary: This protocol can reveal order-of-magnitude savings only when observed stream volume, chain effects, replay, reuse, or avoided operational losses produce them. It does not assume those results in advance.
